sentence_stem: The bridge was built in 1990, and
correct_completion: it is still used by thousands of people every day.
full_sentence: The bridge was built in 1990, and it is still used by thousands of people every day.
acceptable_variants: it still carries cars across the river today.
it remains open to traffic even now.

options.text: it are still used by thousands of people every day.
options.why_wrong: The subject 'it' takes the singular verb 'is', not 'are'.

options.text: tomorrow it will be painted by students.
options.why_wrong: This describes a future event with no link to the bridge being used, so the sentence does not continue logically.

options.text: it is still used by thousands of people every day.
it was not finished in 1990 at all.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stem, which says the bridge was built in 1990, so it does not complete the idea.

grammar_focus: Present simple passive voice after a past event
explanation: After 'and', the second clause must continue the idea of the bridge with a logical, grammatically correct present passive verb phrase. Options that change the time frame or break subject-verb agreement do not fit.
translation: A ponte foi construída em 1990, e ainda é usada por milhares de pessoas todos os dias.
